newsitem.title: USA: D&P upgrades 360 Communications senior notes.
newsitem.headline: D&P upgrades 360 Communications senior notes.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said it has upgraded 360 Communications Co's senior unsecured notes to triple-B-minus from double-B-plus.
360 has more than $1.7 billion in senior notes and bank debt outstanding.

D&P cited 360's strong position, its balanced market composition and D&P's expectation for continued improvement in credit measures. The rating also incorporates the increase in competition posed by personal communications services and the company's strategy to externally grow its cellular asset base.
360 should continue to experience good growth in subscribers, revenue and cash flow over the near term, albeit at a lower overall rate, D&P said in a statement.
D&P said it expects that PCS competition will vary market by market and progress in stages, as PCS network coverage improves and interoperability issues are resolved.
360 provides cellular services to two million customers in more than 100 markets in 16 states. The company also resells residential long distance and paging services.
